description: This file defines a React functional component 'Sidebar' which renders a sidebar navigation menu for a web application. It includes role-based menu filtering, icons from '@ant-design/icons', menu groupings, and navigation logic.

methods.name: navigateToPage
methods.description: Updates the URL search parameters and calls the 'setPage' callback to change the currently viewed page.

methods.name: filterItemsByRole
methods.description: Filters menu items recursively based on the 'roles' property and the current user's role.

methods.name: buildMenuItems
methods.description: Constructs the menu items array for the Ant Design Menu component, including handling role restrictions and menu groupings.

methods.name: findMenuItemKey
methods.description: Determines the key of the menu item that corresponds to the current page, for setting the selected menu item.
